newsitem.title: USA: Raychem down on margin, currency concerns.
newsitem.headline: Raychem down on margin, currency concerns.

text.p: Shares of plastic products maker Raychem Corp fell sharply Thursday, one day after the company reported third quarter earnings and said foreign exchange rates would continue to pressure its results.

Although Raychem reported an increase in its third quarter earnings, it also noted that "adverse movements" in exchange rates shaved about $5 million of its latest third quarter net, and were expected to continue to pressure near-term results.

After the earnings were reported, Merrill Lynch analyst Jerry Labowitz lowered his near-term rating on the stock to neutral from accumulate, citing a shift in the company's sales mix to lower margin products.
